statement:
The recorded value “left” is unsafe and incorrect for this case because the surgeon and signed consent specify the right knee, so I will list the operation for the right knee.
Ms Farrell’s right knee replacement is now on Thursday’s 09:00 theatre list (BK-551), using the correct side rather than the incorrectly recorded left knee.
